{{Quote|Wear the hat. I don't care if it looks goofy or you can't see. Hypothermia is the alternative.|An Alliance [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]]|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Alliance Cold Weather Gloves}}</ref>}}
The '''Alliance Cold Weather armor''' was an insulated [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by the troops of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operating in extremely frigid environment. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the outfit provided protection to Rebel soldiers against the planet's cold conditions.

==Description==
{{Quote|Not just any gloves. They're designed for frigid climates like Hoth.|An Alliance quartermaster|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge" />}}
[[File:Alliance_Cold_Weather_Gloves.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Alliance Cold Weather Gloves.]]
The Alliance Cold Weather armor was a light colored [[Padded armor/Legends|padded armor]] designed to resist the most extreme cold temperatures.<ref name="SWG padded vest">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Alliance Cold Weather Padded Vest}}</ref> It offered a high degree of protection against energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but lesser protection from kinetic damage. The complete armor set consisted of a [[Alliance Cold Weather Headgear|headgear]]<ref name="SWG:C11" /> that incorporated face mask, [[Anti-glare goggles/Legends|anti-glare goggles]] and a [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]],<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a padded vest, padding for each bicep, bracers for each forearm, darker-colored gloves, a belt, darker-colored leggings, boots and a [[Alliance Cold Weather Backpack/Legends|backpack]].<ref name="SWG:C11" /> The [[Thermal flak jacket|jacket]] was worn over a padded or lightweight long-sleeved tunic. Members stationed inside the base typically wore a vest with a high padded collar, while those serving on the Hoth exterior wore a smaller, thicker vest without a collar that fit over their jacket. Both versions of the vest could be adorned with the individual's rank insignia.<ref name="ESB" /> The backpack contained equipment intended to protect the wearer from [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermia]] such as a small heater and survival gear.<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Alliance Cold Weather Backpack}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Dug_In_SWDA.png|thumb|right|220px|Rebel troops wearing Alliance Cold Weather armor on Hoth.]]
During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance Cold Weather armor was the primary outfit worn by [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] deployed on frozen worlds,<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="EaW" /><ref name="Battlefront" /> including [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]],<ref name="Battlefront" /> [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and [[Polus]].<ref name="EaW" /> The armor was also used by specialized infantry such as [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel marksmen]], [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|vanguards]],<ref name="Battlefront" /> [[Medic/Legends|medics]],<ref name="TotG">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Tauntaun Trooper|tauntaun troopers]],<ref name="ESB" /> as well as the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]]' [[Wilderness Fighters]].<ref name="FFGTCG">{{FFGTCG|set=The Desolation of Hoth|cardname=Wilderness Fighters}}</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], by the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the Cold Weather armor equipped virtually all the personnel serving at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters, on the remote ice planet Hoth.<ref name="ESB" />

Years later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]] wore a similar outfit during a [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|mission]] on Hoth during the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]].<ref name="JK:JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
